❓ Frequently asked questions

How are the three margins calculated?

Gross margin = (revenue − COGS) ÷ revenue. Operating margin = (gross profit − operating expenses) ÷ revenue. Net margin uses net income here (no taxes modeled).

COGS vs operating expenses?

COGS is the direct cost of what you sold (materials, direct labor). Operating expenses are overhead: rent, salaries, marketing, admin.

What is a good net margin?

It varies by industry — 10% net is strong for retail, while software often exceeds 20%. Compare against your own industry's benchmarks.
